prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1019; do not mention it.)
text: This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. We ask that you provide the policy limits for all coverage that applies to the insured driver involved in this collision, including any excess or umbrella coverage, and that you confirm the amounts in writing. We also request that your company preserve all evidence related to this loss, including vehicle data, photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file materials, and any dashcam or surveillance footage. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter promptly and confirm that the preservation request has been placed in your file.
